project_identity.name: 0x06-regular_expressions
project_identity.scope: Introduction to regular expressions (regex) and their application in pattern matching, text processing, and data validation.
project_identity.description: Covers regex syntax, pattern matching, text processing, capture groups, and validation in Ruby and shell.

technicalSkills: Understand what regular expressions are and their purpose
Master basic and advanced regex syntax and patterns
Apply regular expressions to find and extract data from text
Implement regex using Ruby's scan method
Create patterns with character classes and quantifiers
Use anchors to match start and end positions in strings
Extract specific information using capture groups
Validate formats such as phone numbers and email addresses
